# Closing Day Ready

> Closing Day Ready provides comprehensive educational content for people buying a home. From understanding mortgages and improving credit to making offers, negotiating contracts, completing inspections, and preparing for closing day, the platform delivers practical resources that help buyers make informed decisions while avoiding costly mistakes.

## Articles

- [First-Time Buyer Hub: Your Complete Guide to Buying a Home](https://closingdayready.com/articles/first-time-home-buyer/): Not sure where to start? This guide walks first-time buyers through every stage — from credit and savings to inspections, offers, and closing day.
- [First-Time Homebuyer Timeline Checklist: Phase-by-Phase Plan](https://closingdayready.com/articles/first-time-homebuyer-timeline-checklist/): A phase-by-phase action checklist that turns the homebuying timeline into concrete tasks you can own, track, and complete from prep to closing day.
- [How Long to Save a Down Payment: First-Time Buyer Guide](https://closingdayready.com/articles/how-long-does-it-take-to-save-for-a-down-payment-first-time-buyer/): Most first-time buyers need years to save a down payment, but the right loan type, savings plan, and assistance programs can cut that timeline significantly.
- [Timeline for Buying Your First Home: A Phase-by-Phase Guide](https://closingdayready.com/articles/timeline-for-buying-your-first-home/): Learn the realistic 4–8 month timeline for buying your first home, broken down phase by phase, so you can plan your finances and move-in date with confidence.
- [Offer Accepted: Your First-Timer's 30–45-Day Closing Plan](https://closingdayready.com/articles/what-happens-after-offer-is-accepted-first-time-buyer/): Your offer was accepted—now what? Here's the week-by-week closing timeline every first-time buyer needs to protect their deal and close on time.
- [Stronger Mortgage Pre-Approval: 7 Moves Before Your Offer](https://closingdayready.com/articles/better-mortgage-pre-approval/): Learn 7 proven ways to get a better mortgage pre-approval—reduce DTI, seek underwritten letters, grow reserves, and protect your file through closing.
- [Home Inspection Checklist for Buyers: Room-by-Room Guide](https://closingdayready.com/articles/home-inspection-checklist-for-buyers/): A complete home inspection checklist for buyers covering every major system, red flags to watch for, and how to use findings to negotiate effectively.
- [Home Inspection Checklist for Sellers: What to Fix First](https://closingdayready.com/articles/home-inspection-checklist-for-sellers/): Prepare for the buyer's home inspector with this seller checklist: fix small issues, gather maintenance docs, and protect your final sale price.
- [Home Inspection: Your Complete Guide from Hire to Close](https://closingdayready.com/articles/home-inspection-guide/): A home inspection is one of the most powerful buyer protections in real estate. This guide covers hiring, reading the report, and negotiating to close.
- [Home Inspection Report: Read It and Know What to Negotiate](https://closingdayready.com/articles/home-inspection-report/): Learn how to decode severity ratings in your home inspection report, triage findings into deal-breakers vs. cosmetic issues, and build a smart repair request.
- [Housing Inspection Checklist: Printable Room-by-Room PDF](https://closingdayready.com/articles/housing-inspection-checklist/): Use this printable housing inspection checklist to follow your inspector room by room — never miss a critical system or safety finding on inspection day.
- [How Long Does a Mortgage Pre-Approval Last? A Full Guide](https://closingdayready.com/articles/how-long-does-a-mortgage-pre-approval-last/): A mortgage pre-approval typically lasts 60–90 days, but timing matters. Learn why letters expire, how loan type affects validity, and when to renew.
- [How Long Does Mortgage Pre-Approval Take? Your Timeline](https://closingdayready.com/articles/how-long-does-mortgage-pre-approval-take/): Find out how long mortgage pre-approval takes—from submitting documents to getting your letter—and how to compress the timeline for faster results.
- [Mortgage Pre-Approval Expired? A Step-by-Step Renewal Plan](https://closingdayready.com/articles/mortgage-pre-approval-expired-how-to-renew/): Your mortgage pre-approval expired—now what? Learn which documents to update, whether you face a new credit pull, and how to get a fresh letter fast.
- [Mortgage Pre-Approval: The Complete Guide for Homebuyers](https://closingdayready.com/articles/mortgage-pre-approval/): Learn what mortgage pre-approval really means, how lenders evaluate your finances, what documents you need, and how to shop lenders to save thousands.
- [New Home Inspection Checklist: Before Closing on New Build](https://closingdayready.com/articles/new-home-inspection-checklist/): New construction hides defects behind drywall. Learn which phase inspections to schedule and what to document on your punch list before signing.
